evidence.title: regex101: Online Regex Tester, Builder & Debugger
GitHub - firasdib/Regex101: This repository is currently only used for issue tracking for www.regex101.com

name: regex101
summary: Online regex editor, tester and debugger with explanations, code generation and sharing.
description: regex101 builds, tests, explains and debugs regular expressions with live matches, substitution, extraction, unit tests, benchmarking and code generation. It supports PCRE2, PCRE, JavaScript, Python, Go, Java, .NET, Rust and POSIX ERE/BRE, with saved workspaces, a community library, a regex quiz, an OpenAPI HTTP API and a remote MCP server.
contains: supports PCRE2, PCRE, JavaScript, Python, Go, Java, .NET, Rust, POSIX ERE/BRE
live match highlighting with per-token explanations
substitution, extraction, unit tests and substitution pipeline tools
regex debugger, benchmark, formatter and ReDoS analysis
OpenAPI 3.1 HTTP API and remote MCP server with OAuth sign-in
